scope: Typed protected Store planning, directional grants, captured audience revision and current private lifetime for a SIP primary with a separately admitted native consultant. Full controlled scene/capture cases use an established SIP source; the initial SIP private-slot metadata/receive distinction is also checked. No actual selected/private SIP runtime or DTMF qualification.
implementation: Selected private endpoints now carry ConsultationMediaOrigin and frozen transport-specific snapshots. Native snapshots retain their shape; initial/established SIP snapshots retain their actual call/generation/member/Endpoint/route facts without native signing fields. Complete current native and SIP rosters, original membership epochs, canonical/runtime uniqueness and revision checks remain enforced.

A SIP private slot is purpose-bound to the requested primary. The consultant must match the exact registered native leg, original operation, controller credential/digest, primary Connection, runtime and candidate floor. A public physical sibling of the same Participant cannot inherit its grants. A SIP candidate still needs a separate protected admission and is refused by this component.

Native receive-from-SIP and SIP receive-from-native grants are separate typed pairs under one complete owned interval. They enforce current named receive permission and reciprocal ceilings for the phone Participant identity; the route-owner actor is not a surrogate Participant. No held remote or unrelated physical Connection receives a private pair. Preserved private pairs must match their own original registration/current native context.

Established private-context validation accepts typed SIP-primary metadata and checks its current original audience, physical source and permissions independently of the ended execution credential. Captured outcomes update the actual SIP generation once. Metadata/current actors retain no idle reader and cannot execute or redial.

The service caller has only the explicit conversion for existing native selections. SIP-primary runtime selection/control, actual private media/DTMF and selected SIP candidate handling remain pending. No new public HTTP route, wire schema or SQLite migration is introduced.
